content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with in-house title and mortgage services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes directly to individual buyers through its own sales centers, with mortgage financing."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into lots and sells them to homebuilders, a B2B land business rather than selling completed homes to buyers."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time, move-up and retirement buyers, with its own mortgage arm."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with affiliated mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title and property insurance and mortgage guaranty policies; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells life insurance, mortgages and cemetery services; its business is insurance and death care, not home construction and sales."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title insurance and provides escrow and real estate data and software; it does not build or sell homes."}]}
